summary: §26 Phase B — Coach Video CRUD Dashboard tested end-to-end. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_coach_videos_phase_b.py with 31 tests covering list/detail/upsert/slot/approve/preferred/variant/delete/rescan + 403 client-role checks + regression. Initial run: 8/31 FAILED — 6 due to a critical route-signature bug (POST /coach/videos/slot and DELETE /coach/videos/slot were defined with path params `{key}`/`{slot}` while spec + frontend call them with `?key=` query-param, causing 404), 2 due to a resolver early-return bug in `_lookup_or_fetch_video`. I FIXED the route mismatch by changing both `@api.post('/coach/videos/{key}/slot')` → `@api.post('/coach/videos/slot')` and `@api.delete('/coach/videos/{key}/slot/{slot}')` → `@api.delete('/coach/videos/slot')` at server.py:2391 and 2490 (function signature already read `key: str` and `slot: str` from query). After fix + backend restart: 29/31 PASS. Remaining 2 failures both trace to a single business-logic bug — `_lookup_or_fetch_video` (server.py:2113-2117) returns `None` early when `primary.approval_status == 'rejected'`, completely discarding the record and bypassing `_resolve_display_video`. This defeats the spec: after coach rejects primary, `/api/exercises/video?name=Goblet Squat` MUST return next-priority slot (custom_url/variant/preferred), not video:null. Same bug also makes hotel/home variants unresolvable once primary is rejected. Frontend @1440x900: coach login → sidebar renders 9 nav items in exact spec order (overview/clients/calendar/approvals/library/videos/messages/analytics/profile) — `desktop-nav-videos` present. Videos screen renders correctly: master panel with `videos-search`, `videos-add-btn`, 39 alphabetically-sorted `videos-item-<key>` rows (Turkish Get-Up first as MISSING, then AUTO items). Slash-key `videos-item-90/90 hip rotation` present AND clickable — detail panel loads with real Jeremy Ethier thumbnail. Goblet Squat detail: preferred/last-reviewed header, RE-SCAN YOUTUBE btn, live preview (Athlean-X BZ1TUVr4LFk), 6 slot cards (PRIMARY / CUSTOM URL / CREWFIT UPLOAD (Phase C dimmed) / ALTERNATIVE / YOUTUBE BACKUP / AI IMAGE (Phase C dimmed)). URL paste + save flow works: pasted `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6xwGFn-J_Qw` into `detail-url-input` with `slot-target-custom_url` selected → `detail-url-submit` → custom_url slot re-rendered with `slot-custom_url-prefer` + `slot-custom_url-delete` visible. `slot-custom_url-prefer` click flipped header 'Preferred:' to CUSTOM_URL. Add-modal opens correctly via `videos-add-btn` (input testID is `videos-add-name`, submit is `videos-add-submit` — matched screen source). Mobile hidden route: verified in code /app/frontend/app/(coach)/_layout.tsx registers 'videos' with `href: null` so bottom tabs on 420x900 stay at 5 items — not re-tested since already validated in iteration_9.

critical.issue: `_lookup_or_fetch_video` (server.py:2113-2117) returns None immediately when `existing.primary.approval_status == 'rejected'`, discarding the entire record — bypassing custom_url, variants, preferred_slot. RESULT: After a coach rejects primary, client sees `{video:null, message:'Demo coming soon…'}` even when custom_url or a variant is set and approved. FIX: replace the `if p.get('approval_status') == 'rejected': return None` short-circuit with `existing` return so `_resolve_display_video` can pick the next-priority non-rejected slot. Reproduces via test_client_resolves_hotel_variant + test_client_resolves_home_uses_preferred in test_coach_videos_phase_b.py.

rca_of_issue: Two independent bugs identified, one already fixed. (1) Route-signature mismatch (FIXED): main agent registered POST /coach/videos/{key}/slot + DELETE /coach/videos/{key}/slot/{slot} while frontend + spec use ?key= query-param. Every save/delete from the coach dashboard returned 404 silently. Fixed by removing the path template so FastAPI reads `key`/`slot` as query params (function signatures were already correct). (2) Resolver early-return (NOT fixed — needs main agent): _lookup_or_fetch_video returns None when primary is rejected, discarding the whole record. This makes it impossible for a rejected-primary exercise to serve its custom_url or variant videos to clients. Reproduction: 1) POST /coach/videos/slot?key=goblet+squat body {slot:custom_url, video_url:youtube-url}, 2) POST /coach/videos/approve?key=goblet+squat body {slot:primary, status:rejected}, 3) GET /api/exercises/video?name=Goblet Squat as client → returns video:null instead of custom_url slot. Mitigation: remove the `if p.get('approval_status')=='rejected': return None` block; the downstream `_resolve_display_video` already filters rejected slots per-slot.
